title: Quadratic-pair tester acceptance probability
statement: For every natural number $n$, let $\ell:(\mathbb{F}_2^n)\to\mathbb{F}_2$ and let $q$ assign an element of $\mathbb{F}_2$ to each $n\times n$ matrix over $\mathbb{F}_2$. The probability that the tester querying the oracle at the two sampled vectors and their sum accepts is equal to the probability that the three-query BLR tester accepts $\ell$; equivalently, both are the probability over independent uniform $x,y\in\mathbb{F}_2^n$ that $\ell(x)+\ell(y)=\ell(x+y)$.
hypotheses_covered: A function from $n\times n$ matrices over $\mathbb{F}_2$ to $\mathbb{F}_2$
